article.headline: Kintavious Dozier scores 24 as Alabama A&M beats North Alabama 68-60
article.description: — Kintavious Dozier's 24 points helped Alabama A&M defeat North Alabama 68-60 on Monday night.
article.linkText: Kintavious Dozier scores 24 as Alabama A&M beats North Alabama 68-60

categories.description: North Alabama Lions @ Alabama A&M Bulldogs

event.description: North Alabama Lions @ Alabama A&M Bulldogs

keywords: North Alabama Lions @ Alabama A&M Bulldogs
article.story: HUNTSVILLE, Ala. -- — Kintavious Dozier's 24 points helped Alabama A&M defeat North Alabama 68-60 on Monday night. Dozier added five rebounds and four steals for the Bulldogs (6-4). Koron Davis scored 16 points while going 4 of 9 from the floor, including 2 for 6 from 3-point range, and 6 for 6 from the line. Canin Jefferson finished with 20 points for the Lions (5-5). Dallas Howell added 16 points and Donte Bacchus pitched in with 10 points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
